messages:
Elliot (CSM): Heads-up — Oakmont Labs seat activity slipped again, ~48% down last 14d vs prior 30d. Saw a new procurement contact (Eric M.) in their threads. Can we triage?
Priya (AE): Yikes. Are they in the middle of a POC or already on paid seats?
Elliot (CSM): Paid annual contract, 120 seats. POC ended Q4. Renew date ~ 2026-07-02. Usage drop started ~2 weeks after their newly-hired ML lead joined.
Jonas (RevOps): Pulling raw metrics now. Quick query: `SELECT account_id, date, active_seats FROM seat_events WHERE account='oakmont' AND date >= current_date - interval '60 days'` — will post chart.
ops-bot: Dashboard snapshot: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/oakmont-activity (last updated 2m ago)
Sofia (Product): Any recent model regressions or infra incidents that could explain a drop?
Aisha (Eng): No infra incidents on their cluster. Kernel-level latency spikes on 2026-02-12 but automatically mitigated; not correlated with behavioral drop. No model quality regressions reported in evals for their primary model.
Priya (AE): I pinged Eric M. — he said they're running a competitive bake-off with "BlueCliff AI" and evaluating cost per inference + cold-start latency.
Elliot (CSM): Ok that's new. Sounds like procurement + technical evaluation. We should try to (1) re-establish their champion, (2) offer a short workload cost report, (3) schedule a live walkthrough of performance + fallbacks.
Jonas (RevOps): I generated a quick cost delta for their 75th percentile session: 
```
- Current avg token cost: $0.0042/token
- Estimated BlueCliff reported cost: ~$0.0036/token (from rep notes)
- Projected monthly delta at current volume: ~$2.1k
```
Priya (AE): I'll ask for their workload sample and offer a 2-week dedicated trial on a performance profile (Redwood Dedicated lite) to prove consistent latency.
Sofia (Product): If we do a trial, recommend we surface these checks in the console: per-route latency, KV cache hit-rate, and prefix cache savings. Those are our strongest levers.
Elliot (CSM): Agree. Also need to loop in legal/procurement — any T&Cs that were blocking before?
Jonas (RevOps): No outstanding legal flags on file. Procurement is new contact though — might want a short SOW + data residency note.
Aisha (Eng): Quick ask — can we get a sanitized prompt/sample to run through quantized variant and a latency snapshot? I can bench it and share numbers by EOD.
Priya (AE): I can get samples. Will coordinate with Elliot to request them.
Elliot (CSM): Action items: @Priya get workload samples + availability; @Aisha run bench and share numbers; @Jonas prepare cost delta slide; @Sofia prep console demo focusing on caching/batching; I will schedule a 45m working session with Eric + new ML lead + exec sponsor (propose Wed 10am PT).
Priya (AE): Proposed outreach note (short): "Eric — noticed seat activity dip and learned you're running a bake-off. Can we run a short perf + cost check with your workload? We'll bring bench numbers and a brief compare to help your procurement discussion." Thoughts?
Elliot (CSM): Clean. Add CTA to share workload or allow a 1-hour sandbox window.
Sofia (Product): Add a line offering to enable KV/prefix caching for their trial so they can see delta live.
Priya (AE): Got it. I'll send after lunch.
Jonas (RevOps): Slide deck draft uploaded: https://redwood.internal/slides/oakmont-triage (contains cost math + renewal timeline).
Aisha (Eng): Bench results will include p50/p90/p99 and cold vs warmed KV; aim to include token breakdown.
Elliot (CSM): If they push pricing only, our fallback is a limited discount + commit to a canary baseline with rollback policies.
Priya (AE): Noted. I'll flag that in the outreach.
Elliot (CSM): OK — thanks team. Let's reconvene after bench + slide are ready. If we have no reply by Tue EOD, Priya will escalate to the executive sponsor for alignment. :thumbsup:
Priya (AE): Copy.
ops-bot: Reminder set — follow up check on 1965432100 in 48h.
